items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Serge and I became very good friends, but he was always in bands I wasn’t, except for Georgie Auld’s band for a while.

ctx.x: Was Serge Chaloff there or is that before your time.

He had been there before me. Serge was in Van – Serge and I became very good friends, but he was always in bands I wasn’t, except for Georgie Auld’s band for a while. He was with Georgie when I was with Boyd and Georgie Auld and Boyd Raeburn and Buddy Rich were all bands that were sort of farm teams for Woody’s band. That’s how it always worked out and I was in all those bands but I never played in Woody’s band.
And I guess Sonny Dunham’s was too, right?
